description: This file defines an interface for session connection operations with Amazon DynamoDB, including methods for reading, writing, deleting, and garbage collecting sessions.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from DynamoDB using the session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to DynamoDB with a session ID, data, and change status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a session record from DynamoDB using the session ID.

methods.name: deleteExpired
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on expired sessions stored in DynamoDB.
